Khushi Santosh Patil’s journey through the STEP program at 3RI Technologies highlights the importance of learning programming and web development concepts. Her transition to an Associate Software Engineer role at Truly Capital marks an important step in her professional journey. Table of Contents Shrutika Patil October 22, 2026 4:51 pm Khushi Santosh Patil’s journey reflects how structured training and regular practice can help learners prepare for their next professional step. Through STEP in Python Full Stack training, she developed her programming knowledge and gained an understanding of web development concepts. She was able to improve her technical abilities and get ready for opportunities in the software business due to the learning process. Later, she started working as an Associate Software Engineer at Truly Capital , applying her knowledge in a professional work environment. The Challenge For Khushi, learning Python Full Stack development was not just about understanding programming basics. She was interested in learning how various technologies collaborate to create practical web apps. She needed a proper learning approach to improve her coding skills, understand web development concepts, and gain confidence through regular practice. She joined Python classes in Pune through STEP in Python Full Stack training to improve her technical knowledge and prepare for job opportunities in the software industry. The Learning Approach at 3RI Technologies Khushi was interested in learning Python Full Stack development through hands-on experience. She joined the STEP in Python Full Stack course at 3RI Technologies , a 5-month program that covers Python, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Django, and MySQL. In order to help students understand how these technologies are utilized to create web apps, the training includes hands-on projects. The program provides project work, interview preparation, and placement support in addition to technical study. Learners can enhance their coding abilities and get ready for chances in the IT sector with this learning path. The Python Full Stack Training Path Khushi’s educational journey focused on understanding Python Full Stack development in detail and practicing each idea. She improved knowledge of how these technologies interact and learnt key programming and web development principles through structured training at 3RI Technologies. Month 1 – Learning Python Basics: Khushi’s learning path starts with Python fundamentals, including variables, data types, operators, conditions, loops, and functions. These topics help learners write simple programs and understand basic coding logic. Month 2 – Core Python and Programming Skills: The next stage focuses on working with strings, lists, dictionaries, modules, and files. Learning these concepts helps learners organise their code, handle information, and solve common programming problems. Month 3 – Front-End Development: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Bootstrap introduce learners to website structure, page design, and interactive features. These technologies help in their understanding of how a web application’s front end functions. Month 4 – Django and Database Concepts: Learners are introduced to Django for web application development and MySQL for managing data. They learn how pages, application logic, and databases connect to support different website features. Month 5 – Projects and Application Development: The final stage focuses on bringing different concepts together through practical project work. Learners can practise building web applications, working with databases, and preparing for technical interviews and job opportunities. By learning Python Full Stack concepts step by step and practising her skills, Khushi developed her programming knowledge and prepared to enter the IT industry. Her training at 3RI Technologies helped her work towards her career goal, and she began her professional journey as an Associate Software Engineer at Truly Capital . The Outcome of Python Full Stack Training in Pune The Python Full Stack training at 3RI Technologies helped Khushi Santosh Patil learn programming and understand how web applications are developed. Learning Python and other web technologies gave her a chance to build her technical knowledge and understand how different parts of an application work together. The Placement support at 3RI Technologies helped her prepare for career opportunities and take a step towards working in the IT industry. What She Learned How It Helped Her Python Programming Helped her understand coding basics and use programming logic to solve problems. Front-End Development Introduced her to website structure, page design, and interactive features used in web applications. Back-End Development Helped her understand how application features work behind the scenes and how different parts connect. Database Management Gave her an understanding of how information is stored, accessed, and managed in applications. Practical Work Provided opportunities to apply programming concepts through exercises and projects, making technical topics easier to understand. Career Outcome Her learning journey led to an important career milestone as she began working as an Associate Software Engineer at Truly Capital . Khushi’s journey shows how learning new concepts and practising regularly can help learners move towards their career goals. From Python Full Stack training to starting a professional role, her experience marks an important step in her journey in the IT industry. Python Full Stack Training at 3RI Technologies Starting a career in software development becomes easier when you have a clear understanding of programming and application development. The STEP in Python Full Stack program at 3RI Technologies helps learners build their knowledge of Python, web technologies, backend development, and databases through a structured learning process. Practical exercises and projects give learners a chance to use these skills while understanding how applications work. In addition to technical learning, the program helps students get ready for the next phase of their careers by providing project practice, interview coaching, certification, and placement assistance. Khushi Santosh Patil’s journey from Python Full Stack training to becoming an Associate Software Engineer at Truly Capital highlights how learning new skills and putting them into practice can open the way to professional opportunities in the IT industry.
